answer: Joint-liability trellis bonds: each identity joins a node of six and posts a bond the node shares. Enrollment stamps a pigment hashed from all six bonds, so hiding two clones in one node collides on pigment when an auditor re-derives it. Any proven sybil slashes the whole node bond, never one share. Spreading k clones across k nodes means k times five unrelated co-signers with real history who refuse strangers. A per-epoch pulse of distinct liveness freezes nodes answering in lockstep.
